subject: science
concept: Understanding the gas laws (Boyle's Law, Charles's Law) and their relationships between pressure, volume, and temperature
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Structure and Properties of Matter) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student compresses a physical syringe or balloon model and observes pressure/volume changes
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a gas law scenario (heating, compressing) to its correct outcome graph
exercise.abstract: Student calculates a missing gas variable (pressure, volume, or temperature) using the appropriate gas law

misconception_flags: confuses which gas law applies when temperature is held constant versus when pressure is held constant

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
